description: This Java interface, EffectedSubjects, defines methods for retrieving sets of granted and revoked AuthorizationSubject instances within the context of resource permissions. It mandates immutability in implementations and is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.model.enforcers package.

methods.name: getGranted
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of AuthorizationSubjects that are granted within the scope.

methods.name: getRevoked
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of AuthorizationSubjects that are revoked within the scope.
